entries.260ebcddc675513e: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥861,003 million, down from ¥953,316 million in the previous year. The breakdown is ¥858,427 million from the advertising business and ¥2,575 million from other businesses. By customer location, revenue was ¥622,779 million for Japan and ¥238,223 million for overseas. Factors behind the decline in revenue include the move of United Co., Ltd. from a subsidiary through the fiscal year ended March 2025 to an equity-method affiliate in the fiscal year ended March 2026, and a reactionary decline in government and public-sector business.
